title: Sennacherib's Attack on Jerusalem
description: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah's reign, the Assyrian king Sennacherib captures the fortified cities of Judah and sends the field commander Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem. Rabshakeh mocks Hezekiah's trust in Egypt and in the Lord, and demands surrender. The palace administrator Eliakim, the secretary Shebna, and the recorder Joah ask him to speak Aramaic, but he answers in Hebrew to frighten the people on the wall. The people remain silent as Hezekiah had commanded, and the three men return to the king with their clothes torn and report what was said.
